record: *** URUGUAY PADRON, calle San Juan No 60, household 59 ***
does it require him to be ALIVE?: *** YES - AND IT IS THE LAST ONE ***
why: *** A census enumerates the LIVING. *** He is returned as *** Sancho, 'andaluz', 45 ***, with Maria Fernandez 36, six children, his father-in-law Rodrigo Fernandez 63, and four enslaved people. *** This is the last document in the world that shows Sancho Llerena alive. ***
He is named as the father. Fathers are named whether present or not, and the formula does not say.

record: Montevideo - baptism of his son Luis Escolastico
why: Named as father. The act's value is elsewhere: it gives his parents and Andalucia.
